How to play

Place each city in one matching square. Fill all 16 to complete the card; rows, columns and diagonals count as bingo lines.

Skip safely, or use your one wildcard to fill every matching empty square with the current city. A wrong choice discards the current city and skips the next one.

Each card has a fixed sequence of 32 cities. Next card cycles through five demos. Restart replays the same sequence.

Population uses the fixed GeoNames city record, not the metro area. Hold over a square for its definition, or use Category details below.
